sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose
The Property Tax Response Generation tool is a specialized subflow designed to drive operational efficiency and municipal accountability. It automates the creation of high-quality email responses for complex property tax enquiries, ensuring every citizen interaction is handled with transparency, accuracy, and timely service.
Action & Logic
Trigger Condition: This tool is activated immediately upon the completion of the property account data analysis and response synthesis phase, ensuring civic compliance through accurate and timely communication.
Data Integration: It synthesizes the generated email content with existing Work Notes to provide a transparent, contextual record of the response for agent review and municipal oversight.
Record Linking: It utilizes the Case Sys ID to maintain a robust audit trail, programmatically linking the generated email response to the master property tax case record for seamless, accountable case management.
Inputs
Email Reply (email_reply): The generated response content required to address the citizen's enquiry, ensuring alignment with municipal tax policies, assessment rules, and civic communication standards.
Work Notes (work_notes): Critical history and account context updated to reflect the response sent, maintaining service continuity for Revenue Services agents and the resident.
Case Sys ID: The unique system identifier (can also be the case number) for the case, ensuring full auditability and record integrity throughout the lifecycle of the tax enquiry.
Key Output
The tool facilitates the immediate generation and logging of a property tax enquiry response, mitigating compliance risk by ensuring a standardized, accurate communication trail. It supports civic service goals by providing residents with prompt, reliable information and protects Revenue Services agents from high-volume burnout by eliminating repetitive manual drafting.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Draft Email Response
